# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta — Organization — Federation

> 16 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta — Organization under Federation. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Federation

- [Add Federation Rule Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/rules/workspaces/add.md): Tagged ID of the workspace to enable this rule for.
- [Archive Federation Issuer](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/issuers/archive.md): Archive a federation issuer.
- [Archive Federation Rule](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/rules/archive.md): Archive a federation rule.
- [Create Federation Issuer](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/issuers/create.md): Register an OIDC issuer that Anthropic will trust for workload identity federation in your organization.
- [Create Federation Rule](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/rules/create.md): Create a federation rule owned by your organization.
- [Get Federation Issuer](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/issuers/retrieve.md): Retrieve a federation issuer by its ID (`fdis_...`).
- [Get Federation Rule](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/rules/retrieve.md): Retrieve a federation rule by its ID (`fdrl_...`).
- [Issuers](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/issuers.md): Include archived resources. Defaults to false.
- [List Federation Issuers](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/issuers/list.md): Include archived resources. Defaults to false.
- [List Federation Rule Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/rules/workspaces/list.md): List workspaces where this federation rule is enabled.
- [List Federation Rules](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/rules/list.md): Include archived resources. Defaults to false.
- [Remove Federation Rule Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/rules/workspaces/remove.md): Disable a federation rule for a workspace.
- [Rules](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/rules.md): Include archived resources. Defaults to false.
- [Update Federation Issuer](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/issuers/update.md): Partially update a federation issuer.
- [Update Federation Rule](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/rules/update.md): Partially update a federation rule.
- [Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation/rules/workspaces.md): Tagged ID of the workspace to enable this rule for.
